name: Gilded Tern gangway gate
notes: The gate at the head of the Gilded Tern's gangway (mw-e40.1, route is mw-e40.14): Captain Hesketh's crew keep it until Hesketh hands over the tern-gangway-pass token, on the debt of honour or the crew deal (mw-e40.28). Tier 3, cannot be picked.
hint: The crew keep the gangway and know only the Captain's brass token. Ask Hesketh.
